1.consolidated_definition: Insecto coleóptero de cuerpo casi circular, convexo y negro que arroja un líquido maloliente al tocarlo. Coccinellidae, Coccinella spp.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Beetle of the family Coccinellidae, genus Coccinella, characterized by a nearly circular, convex, and black body that emits a foul-smelling liquid upon contact.
